verdict.rationale: vLLM exposes an OpenAI-compatible API server (plus Anthropic Messages API and gRPC) with tool calling/reasoning parser support and streaming outputs, which are exactly the interfaces coding agents (Cursor, Continue, OpenAI SDK-based agents, etc.) use to plug in a custom backend; community evidence confirms users value the OpenAI-compatible API for integration. Missing for 10: a first-party guide or example specifically showing a coding agent (e.g., Cursor/Continue/Aider) configured against vLLM, and independent hands-on confirmation of tool-calling compatibility in agentic workflows.
